description: UPs first non-govt AI lab opens in Varanasi. Latest Updates. On Saturday, at 4 PM, a state-of-the-art AI (Artificial Intelligence) and Robotics Lab was inaugurated at PM Shri Rajkiya Queens Inter College, Varanasi.
body_lead: - English News - Local - Uttar pradesh - Varanasi - Varanasi AI Lab Inaugurated For Students | Tech Education Boost UP's first non-government AI lab opens in Varanasi:Students to receive advanced technical education - Copy link A state-of-the-art Artificial Intelligence (AI) and Robotics Lab was inaugurated at 4 pm on Saturday at PM Shri Rajkiya Queens Inter College in Varanasi.
